added: Adding or removing a passage on an assessment now leaves a receipt saying who did it and when, like every other change in the app. (#452)
fixed: In the setup wizard, the Language list for an existing project is now a required field to the browser and screen readers too, like Name, Project, New project name and Active until (it was already marked "(required)" on screen and checked before Next). (#450)

When a survey's language name is spelled in a way the translator refuses (for example with a symbol in it), participants' page words now stay saved on their device after the first load instead of being translated again every time; the welcome line stays in English, and refused lines are asked for again after a day in case the refusal was temporary. (#454)
